title: Compact rollout status: contrast, microcopy & edge case polish for multi-tenant cost view
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
Design pass for the compact rollout status component used on the multi-tenant Cost Overview and Rollouts list. This ticket covers: visual contrast improvements for low-vision users, revised microcopy to reduce ambiguity in failure/paused/partial states, edge-case alignment (very long route names, nested rollouts), and handoff-ready redlines for engineering + QA.

Background:
The compact status pill was introduced as a space-saving way to surface rollout health in dense lists. Recent usability feedback surfaced three consistent problems: (1) low contrast between some status tokens and background in compact density, (2) ambiguous microcopy for partial-rollout and throttled states, (3) truncation and layout collapse when route names exceed 48 characters or include emoji/non-latin glyphs.

Scope and deliverables:
- High-fidelity compact-status variants (default, high-contrast, focus state, keyboard target) in Figma.
- Microcopy matrix mapping status -> short + expanded tooltip text.
- Redline PDF and CSS token mapping for colors, padding, min-width, truncation rules.
- Edge-case behaviors and QA checklist (wrapping, RTL, emoji, zoom 200%).
- Developer handoff with component props doc and test vector examples.

Key constraints & trade-offs:
- We must maintain token density targets for compact lists (max 36px high item). Increasing vertical padding is not an option; solution focuses on color contrast + min-width + glyph sizing.
- Avoid adding icons to conserve horizontal space; instead we use stronger color + subtle outline for failed/paused states. Icons could be added as a follow-up if stakeholders prioritize clarity over density.
- For extremely long route names we've chosen a truncation-with-hover approach (truncate to 40 chars + full label in tooltip) rather than wrapping, to keep list height stable.

Acceptance criteria:
- Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for all foreground/background pairs in default and high-contrast variants.
- Microcopy approved by PM and Legal for customer-facing error language.
- Figma prototype demonstrates expected behavior for 5 test vectors (short route, long route, non-latin, emoji, nested rollout).
- Dev signoff: implementation passes the QA checklist below and integrates CSS tokens for colors.

comments: 2026-03-02 - Ava Martinez: Initial design exploration uploaded to Figma. Explored three color palettes: Neutral-Boost, Accent-Outlines, and Surface-Inverse. Asked PM for preference; recommended Neutral-Boost for brand coherence.
2026-03-04 - Priya Shah (PM): Prefer Neutral-Boost; flagged legal review for 'throttled' microcopy. Assigned PM-4321 to coordinate legal signoff.

2026-03-06 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented prototype states and added hover-to-expand tooltip behavior. Noted CSS constraint: list items are rendered by virtualized list, need stable min-width to avoid jitter.

2026-03-08 - Accessibility review (J. Kim): Default tokens do not meet 4.5:1 for 'paused' on light theme. Proposed adjust foreground to #1f2a37 and add 1px semi-transparent outline for contrast without increasing perceived size.
2026-03-10 - Legal (R. Ortega): Approved microcopy for 'paused' and 'partial' states after minor rewording: 'Paused — awaiting approval' and 'Partial — subset of targets updated'.
2026-03-12 - Engineering (ENG-20134): Feasibility OK, asked for exact token names and responsive rules. Noted outstanding dependency: virtualized list needs a stable minHeight prop (ENG-20987).

2026-03-14 - Design review session: Stakeholders (PM, Eng, Research) reviewed Figma prototype. Consensus: accept color tweaks; add explicit test cases for RTL and 200% zoom. Moving to 'In Review' and prepping redlines for handoff.
qa_checklist: Render compact list with 1,000 rows using virtualized list — ensure no layout jitter when hovering tooltip
Contrast verification: run automated axe contrast checks for all status variants on light/dark themes
Truncation: confirm route names >48 chars truncate to 40 chars with '…' and show full label in tooltip
RTL: verify pill direction & tooltip placement for RTL locales
Zoom 200%: ensure pills don't overlap adjacent controls and remain keyboard-focusable
Non-latin / emoji: confirm glyph clipping does not break layout
Keyboard navigation: status pills reachable via tab, tooltip dismissable via Esc
design_decisions: Use Neutral-Boost palette for brand consistency and best perceived contrast in compact density
Add 1px semi-transparent outline for paused/failed states to increase contrast without changing perceived token size
Keep pill height to 24px (matches compact density tokens) and enforce min-width 56px to avoid collapse on short labels
Avoid iconography in compact pill to preserve horizontal space; icons evaluated as follow-up
Truncate long route names and surface full label in tooltip rather than wrapping
visual_redlines: Spacing: left/right padding = 8px, vertical padding = 2px (24px total height)
Colors: status-success fg=#0b6e3f bg=#ecfbf1; status-paused fg=#1f2a37 bg=#fff5e6; status-failed fg=#7b1e1e bg=#fff0f0; outline = rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
Typography: Inter 12/semibold for pill text, letter-spacing 0.02em
Minimum widths: default 56px, danger/failed 64px suggested for readability
Tooltip: max-width 320px, include full route name and microcopy explanation
handoff_notes: Provided component prop contract: <CompactStatus status=\"string\" variant=\"default|high-contrast\" label=\"string\" truncatedLabel=\"string\" tooltipContent=\"string\" minWidth=56>\nDev tasks: integrate CSS tokens, implement hover + keyboard tooltip, add automated contrast tests, provide storybook with the 5 test vectors. Engineering owners must ensure virtualized list sets stable minHeight to prevent layout thrash (see ENG-20987).
